name: Kemonomichi -Ni-
source:
A strong willed magical warrior heroine and an archer fall into the trap of a lizard monster and a squid monster.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036168.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
意志坚强的魔法战士女主角与一名弓箭手，落入了蜥蜴怪物和乌贼怪物的陷阱。

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036168.html]DLsite English[/url]）
